card.title: MOSCOW
card.text: The capital of the Soviet Union and the seat of the government.

Text.SourceString: The capital of the Soviet Union and the seat of the government.
Text.LocalizedString: The capital of the Soviet Union and the seat of the government.

value.value: The time has come for us to take the battle to the Germans. The cold grip of winter makes warfare difficult, but it also keeps the enemy air units at bay.

value.value: The enemy is defending stubbornly. Time to end this.

SourceString.value: The enemy is defending stubbornly. Time to end this.

value.value: Every piece of equipment is to be used against the enemy.

SourceString.value: Every piece of equipment is to be used against the enemy.

value.value: Our factories are pouring out armaments, let’s put it to good use.

value.value: Able-bodied men are streaming in from all over our great nation in our hour of need.

SourceString.value: Able-bodied men are streaming in from all over our great nation in our hour of need.

value.value: We have retaken Klin. On to Kalinin!

value.value: The Germans are sending reinforcements to the sector.

value.value: The Germans are shoring up their defenses. You need to increase your pressure.
